senses.gloss: m. (v. רֶבַע) that which is in its fourth year.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 1:1">Par. I, 1</cite> (difference between <he>רביעי</he> and <cite ref="T00134"><he>רבעי</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:1">Maas. Sh. V, 1</cite> <he>כרם ר׳</he> a vineyard in its fourth year (v.

<cite ref="Leviticus 19:24">Lev. XIX, 24</cite>). Ib. 2 <he>כרם ר׳ היה וכ׳</he> the product of a vineyard in its fourth year was carried to Jerusalem, if the vineyard was within one day’s journey. Ib. 4 <he>כיצד פודין נטע ר׳</he> how are the fruits of a plantation in its fourth year redeemed?; a. v. fr.
